Generated test fixtures (no recorded or third-party content, MIT like the
repository): `tone.wav` is 0.2 s of a 440 Hz stereo tone; `tone.aiff` and
`tone.m4a` (ALAC) are that tone converted with macOS `afconvert`; `cover.jpg`
(600×600) and `back.png` (300×200) are two-colour images drawn with Core
Graphics. `../../flackit/tests/fixtures/tone.flac` is also used.
